tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return Gmail profile (email, message totals, history id).

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Search/list messages. q uses Gmail search syntax (from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, newer_than:7d, etc.).

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get a single message by id. format: full|metadata|minimal|raw.

tools.name: batch_get_messages
tools.description: Fetch many messages in parallel with bounded concurrency. Returns { messages, errors }. Use this instead of looping get_message — one tool call instead of N round-trips for the agent.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message. A text-only body auto-renders to a multipart/alternative email (Gmail-style HTML + plain-text fallback); pass html to override, or plaintextOnly:true to force text/plain. Supports To/Cc/Bcc, attachments (path or base64), inline images (Content-ID; reference as src="cid:..."), threaded replies (set inReplyTo, references, threadId).

from.description: Override From (must be a verified send-as alias)

text.description: Plaintext body. Write it the way a person types plainly into Gmail compose: one continuous line per paragraph, a blank line between paragraphs. It is automatically rendered into a multipart/alternative email with a Gmail-style HTML part (so it reflows on every screen) plus this text as the plain-text fallback. You do not need to write HTML.

html.description: Optional explicit HTML body. Supply this ONLY when you deliberately want custom HTML; it overrides the automatic rendering of `text`. Provide both text and html to set the plain fallback yourself.

plaintextOnly.description: Set true to send a bare text/plain message with no HTML part (e.g. mailing lists, code-only mail). Default false: a text-only body auto-renders to multipart/alternative.

path.description: Local file path. Read at send/draft time.

contentBase64.description: Inline base64 contents if no path
Base64 image data if no path.

cid.description: Content-ID (without angle brackets). Reference in HTML as src="cid:<value>".

inlineImages.description: Inline images embedded via Content-ID. Each needs a cid; reference in your HTML as . Wraps the body in multipart/related.

threadId.description: Gmail threadId — required to dock the message into an existing thread

tools.name: modify_message
tools.description: Add/remove labels on a message. Use INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, or any label id from list_labels.

tools.name: batch_modify_messages
tools.description: Batch add/remove labels across many message ids.

tools.name: batch_delete_messages
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete (skip Trash) up to 1000 messages by id. Irreversible.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Download an attachment. If savePath provided, writes to disk and returns metadata; otherwise returns base64 in .data.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List drafts. q uses Gmail search syntax (constrained to drafts).

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft. Same body shape as send_message, plus optional useSignature (default true) to auto-append the user's default Gmail signature from send-as. For threaded reply drafts, use create_reply_draft instead — it handles In-Reply-To/References/threadId AND quoted parent body.

from.description: Override From (must be a verified send-as alias)

text.description: Plaintext body. Write it the way a person types plainly into Gmail compose: one continuous line per paragraph, a blank line between paragraphs. It is automatically rendered into a multipart/alternative email with a Gmail-style HTML part (so it reflows on every screen) plus this text as the plain-text fallback. You do not need to write HTML.

plaintextOnly.description: Set true to send a bare text/plain message with no HTML part (e.g. mailing lists, code-only mail). Default false: a text-only body auto-renders to multipart/alternative.

path.description: Local file path. Read at send/draft time.

contentBase64.description: Inline base64 contents if no path
Base64 image data if no path.

cid.description: Content-ID (without angle brackets). Reference in HTML as src="cid:<value>".

inlineImages.description: Inline images embedded via Content-ID. Each needs a cid; reference in your HTML as . Wraps the body in multipart/related.

threadId.description: Gmail threadId — required to dock the message into an existing thread

useSignature.description: Auto-append the user's Gmail signature from send-as (default: true). Set false for raw drafts where the body is already complete.

tools.name: create_reply_draft
tools.description: Create a draft as a threaded reply to an existing message. Pulls In-Reply-To, References, threadId, and Re: subject from the parent so the draft appears inside the original Gmail thread. AUTO-INCLUDES the parent body as a Gmail-style quote (gmail_quote/gmail_attr/blockquote markup, byte-matched to Gmail web UI) AND auto-appends the user's send-as signature, so the rendered draft looks like a normal Gmail reply. THIS IS THE ONE THE DEFAULT GMAIL MCP CANNOT DO.

toMessageId.description: Gmail id of the message you are replying to

replyAll.description: If true, Cc all original recipients

body.description: Plaintext reply body, written plainly (one line per paragraph, blank line between). Auto-rendered to a Gmail-style HTML reply with a plain-text fallback; you do not need to write HTML.

html.description: Optional explicit HTML body; overrides the automatic rendering of `body`.

plaintextOnly.description: Force a bare text/plain reply (no HTML part). Default false.

path.description: Local file path. Read at send/draft time.

contentBase64.description: Inline base64 contents if no path
Base64 image data if no path.

cid.description: Content-ID (without angle brackets). Reference in HTML as src="cid:<value>".

inlineImages.description: Inline images via Content-ID. Reference in html as .

includeQuotedParent.description: Append parent body as quoted reply (default: true).

useSignature.description: Auto-append the user's Gmail signature (default: true).

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Replace a draft with new content. Pass id plus the same fields as create_draft.

threadId.description: Gmail threadId — required to dock the message into an existing thread

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Get a thread by id with all messages.

tools.name: batch_get_threads
tools.description: Fetch many threads in parallel with bounded concurrency. Returns { threads, errors }. Most useful for analysis flows that need full conversation context across many threads at once.

tools.name: modify_thread
tools.description: Add/remove labels on a thread (applies to all messages).

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a label. color: { backgroundColor, textColor } (hex; must be from Gmail palette).

tools.name: create_filter
tools.description: Create a filter. criteria: {from, to, subject, query, hasAttachment, ...}; action: {addLabelIds, removeLabelIds, forward}.

tools.name: list_send_as
tools.description: List send-as aliases (each carries its own signature).

tools.name: get_send_as
tools.description: Get a send-as alias by email.

tools.name: create_send_as
tools.description: Create a send-as alias. WORKSPACE-ONLY — fails with 403 "domain-wide authority" on personal Gmail accounts. For personal Gmail, direct the user to Gmail web UI Settings → Accounts → Send mail as.

tools.name: update_send_as
tools.description: Update a send-as alias (e.g. change the signature).

tools.name: delete_send_as
tools.description: Delete a send-as alias. WORKSPACE-ONLY — fails on personal Gmail accounts. Use Gmail web UI Settings → Accounts → Send mail as instead.

tools.name: verify_send_as
tools.description: Send the verification email for a send-as alias.

tools.name: create_forwarding_address
tools.description: Add a forwarding address (sends a verification email).

tools.name: create_delegate
tools.description: Add a delegate. WORKSPACE-ONLY — fails on personal Gmail accounts (requires service account with domain-wide delegation).

tools.name: delete_delegate
tools.description: Remove a delegate. WORKSPACE-ONLY — fails on personal Gmail accounts.

tools.name: list_smime
tools.description: List S/MIME configs for a send-as alias.

tools.name: insert_smime
tools.description: Upload a PKCS#12 cert as S/MIME for a send-as alias.

tools.name: set_default_smime
tools.description: Set the default S/MIME for a send-as alias.

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: Incremental sync of mailbox changes since startHistoryId. Returns messageAdded/Deleted/LabelAdded/LabelRemoved events.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Subscribe to push notifications via a Cloud Pub/Sub topic. Requires Pub/Sub setup; rarely needed for personal use.
